name: Do I need new wiring for non-glare lighting upgrades?

mainEntity.name: Do I need new wiring for non-glare lighting upgrades?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether new wiring is needed depends on your current electrical system and the type of non-glare lighting upgrade you choose. Simple fixture replacements typically utilize existing wiring. However, if you're installing new recessed lighting where none existed, adding new switches or dimmers, or significantly changing the layout of your lighting, new wiring or modifications to existing circuits will likely be required. Our licensed electricians assess your current setup during the consultation to determine if any electrical upgrades are necessary to safely and effectively implement your desired non-glare lighting solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: New wiring may be needed for non-glare lighting upgrades if you're installing new fixtures, switches, or significantly changing the layout, but simple replacements often use existing wiring.
